title: Create Nginx reverse proxy configuration with health checks and zero-downtime upstream
acceptance_criteria: nginx.conf created as reverse proxy to Next.js app on port 3000
Health check endpoint (/api/health) configured for upstream switching
Blue-green upstream blocks defined (app-blue:3001, app-green:3002) with active/passive switching
SSL termination configured with Let's Encrypt certbot auto-renewal
Security headers: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy set
completion_summary: Created nginx/nginx.conf (HTTP→HTTPS redirect, gzip, SSL, proxy). Created nginx-blue.conf and nginx-green.conf for blue-green upstream switching. Created security-headers.conf (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy). Created /api/health endpoint. Created scripts/switch-upstream.sh. Updated docker-compose.yml with app-blue and app-green services.
